item.title: Easy Keto Turkey Lettuce Wraps (Low Carb & Healthy!)
item.description: Craving takeout? Make these savory, low-carb turkey lettuce wraps in under 15 minutes! Only 280 calories and 24g of protein per serving. Perfect for quick weight loss dinners. #KetoRecipes #LowCarbDiet #WeightLossMeals #HealthyDinner #KetoDiet

item.title: Easy Cucumber Lemon Mint Detox Water for Weight Loss
item.description:
Boost your metabolism and stay hydrated with this refreshing cucumber, lemon, and mint detox water! Packed with natural antioxidants to help debloat and support your weight loss journey. Only 5 calories and 0g protein per serving. Simply slice, mix, and chill!
#DetoxWater #WeightLossDrinks #HealthyHabits #FlatTummy #HealthyDiet

item.title: 20-Minute Low Calorie Salmon & Roasted Veggies
item.description: Craving a fast, healthy dinner? Try this easy sheet pan salmon and roasted veggie recipe! Ready in just 20 minutes, packed with protein, and super low calorie. ~420 Calories & 35g Protein. Ingredients: salmon fillet, broccoli, bell peppers, olive oil, lemon, garlic. Prep: Toss veggies with oil and seasonings, place salmon on the pan, and roast at 400°F for 15 mins. #HealthyDinner #WeightLossMeals #SalmonRecipe #HealthyRecipes #CleanEating
